text: Core courses Music Basic Theory, Vocal and Aural Skills, Vocal Music, Piano, Harmony, Music Composition, Chorus and Conducting, Chinese Music History, Foreign Music History, Keyboard Harmony, Piano Accompaniment, Music Appreciation, Form and Analysis, Polyphony, Outline of National Folk Music, Instrumental Music, Instrumental Accessories, Computer Music, Music Aesthetics etc. Objective This objective is to train students to be the high-qualified personnel of music education when they graduate, who grasp the basic theory, knowledge and technical ability of music education; at the same time they have initiative spirit, practice ability and certain capacity of music teaching and research. chooling Length In standards it lasts four years. The minimum of schooling length must be three years and its extension lasts no more than seven years. Credits The minimum of 170 credits must be obtained for graduation. Diploma Bachelor of Arts is granted.
